rationale: Materializes the current best script and adds an endgame-only recurrence schedule: during quant-aware training, the reverse-tail replay gain is floored at 0.72 while final evaluation remains full-gain. This keeps shapes, export, and exact final int8+zlib evaluation unchanged while giving the roundtrip phase updates closer to the scoring path.
title: Quant-Aware Reverse-Tail Gain Floor
